profiles.name: Browser (generic)
profiles.identification: Playwright Chromium with the BOZZ agent profile
common_workflows: Open an allowlisted page and read its visible text
Search a page and open a result by visible title
known_limitations: Only pages that use standard HTML controls and links
No login, payment, upload of unknown files, posting, sending or installing
Depends on Playwright and a Chromium browser being installed
recovery: Re-inspect the page and retry once with a visible label
Dismiss a cookie banner by declining it
Stop and ask the user when the page state is ambiguous
profiles.notes: Verified only when the browser-playwright suite records passing results. Otherwise Experimental, never claimed as working.

profiles.name: YouTube (read-only)
profiles.identification: www.youtube.com in the BOZZ agent browser
common_workflows: Search YouTube and read the result titles
Open a video by title match and read its title, channel and date text
known_limitations: Read-only. Posting a comment is Tier 3 and refused before any browser call.
Layout changes can break a title match; the agent stops and asks instead of guessing
Not verified by a recorded passing suite in this milestone
recovery: Stop and ask the user if the title is missing
profiles.notes: Experimental. No automated YouTube layout suite has been recorded.

profiles.name: BOZZ mock site (test-only)
common_workflows: Search for A2D, open the newest video and prepare a comment draft
Decline the cookie banner and read the delayed result
known_limitations: The comment box is a mock. It stores nothing and has no submit route.
The site only runs from the local BOZZ backend
profiles.notes: Verified only when the mock-site-workflow suite records passing results.
